nodes.label: desktop memory - the dual-dataset eval plan, HERB scored and Bonnier naturalistic

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. SCOPED 2026-06-13: the v2 build and eval is HERB-only for now and Bonnier is DEFERRED to a later phase, on the user's 'the Bonnier set will have to wait until some other time'; the dual-dataset intent survives as the eventual plan and nothing Bonnier gets built now. The original plan evaluates the same artefact and pipeline on two datasets, each playing a distinct role: HERB is the quantitative, scored run - graph against a Lucene baseline, RAGAS with authoritative ground truth in the gold-100 - and is framed as an established enterprise-RAG benchmark from Salesforce, never as one found online, because its reproducibility is a strength; Bonnier News data is the naturalistic evaluation, running ingestion over real multi-system content with self-authored questions and no comparable RAGAS-versus-baseline numbers, because there is no independent ground truth. The validity framing the user converged on: real Bonnier data strengthens external and ecological validity and practical relevance, NOT internal validity and not the quantitative results. The Bonnier data ask is format-first, not volume-first - one native raw dump per ingestion pipe, unchanged format, at most 150 MB total, one topic per week so content overlaps across pipes
